referencePolicy: URLs point to official documentation or project repositories. evidenceNote distinguishes proposed engineering requirements and competitive benchmark scope. References are not per-vendor support checkmarks, not copied specifications and not a claim of clinical readiness. Verify current edition, module and version before any product-specific parity claim.
easiKnownFoundationGaps: Standard display decoders emit RGBA; a raw scalar frame contract is needed for accurate measurements, GPU windowing and volume work.
Current native multiframe detection is modality-gated; frame access must be derived from validated object and frame metadata.
Empty basic offset tables and multiple fragments per frame require robust frame-boundary logic and extended-offset handling.
Enhanced shared and per-frame functional groups need consistent normalization and precedence.
Default bulk streaming does not materialize pixels in Instance outputs; a frame consumer must explicitly own and release retained bytes.
toInstances currently retains completed instances and emits a cumulative collection; a viewer cannot claim bounded memory based on callback streaming alone.
Optional JPEG-LS, JPEG2000 and HTJ2K providers require actual profile-specific assets and independent decoded-sample validation.
Existing SEG, SR and presentation-state accessors do not establish complete visualization, editing or interchange support.
